notices.title: Fee Structure Published for Academic Year 2026-27
notices.body: The fee structure for AY 2026-27 has been published for all programs. Semester 1 fees are payable at the time of admission and Semester 2 fees are payable in January. Tuition and other fees per semester are due by 7th July and 7th January every year; a fine of Rs. 50/- per day applies after the due date. Hostel facility is optional. See the Fees Center for the full program-wise breakdown.
